messages:
tariq: Heads-up: support case where copying Go quickstart caused generator goroutine growth. Quickstart creates streams with context.Background().

mei: Oof. We should show using the request ctx (r.Context()) or a derived timeout and call defer gen.Close() immediately. Example to paste: 
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
gen := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer gen.Close()
for gen.Next() { /* handle tokens */ }
```
Keep client long-lived; pass ctx to calls.

jordan: Also found retry helper sleeping with time.Sleep during backoff; that ignores ctx.Done() and amplifies leaks. I proposed changing to time.NewTimer + select on timer.C and ctx.Done().

tariq: Can we add a CI smoke that cancels a generator and asserts goroutine count returns to baseline? Might be flaky but useful as regression guard.

mei: Agreed. Add flakiness guard (repeat until stable) and a short timeout. Also document "don't use context.Background() for request-scoped streams" in quickstart sidebar.

ci-bot: CI: branch fix/go-gen-ctx passed (build #9432) :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: docs PR opened to replace quickstart snippet and add sidebar; linking retry patch and test.

jordan: One more ergonomics note: streaming types use mixed method names (Close vs CloseStream). Let's standardize to Close() in a follow-up RFC to avoid copy-paste confusion. I'll open RFC and add migration notes.

tariq: Thanks all 44d I'll update the sample-app repro and link to the docs PR in the support ticket.
